data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net release of $11.0m in prior year reserves, reflecting a profit of $15.5m on the 2021 year of account, partially offset by a loss of $4.5m on the 2020 year of account. The 2020 year of account was adversely impacted by US catastrophes, including Winter Storm Uri. The syndicate also noted an explicit $16.9m uplift to net technical provisions due to economic inflation, which applies to 2022-2025 financial years, indicating a mixed impact on reserves.
